adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in Office365CalendarService.ts. Looking at the diff, line 73 shows `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` which always selects the first destination calendar from the array. However, when EventManager.ts creates events for multiple hosts (line 370 shows `await createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`), it passes the full event with all destination calendars but only passes the specific externalId as a third parameter. The Office365 service ignores this third parameter and always uses the first calendar in the array (mainHostDestinationCalendar). This means when creating an event for a cohost with Office365, it will try to create the event on the organizer's calendar instead of the cohost's calendar, which would fail since the cohost's credential doesn't have access to the organizer's mailbox. The same pattern exists in LarkCalendarService. GoogleCalendarService correctly uses `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to select the right calendar.
